devices: Available for iPhone, iPad and Android. Check the linked store for your device’s current compatibility.
price: CourtsideView is free to download. Local Scorekeeper is free to use. FanView is free to broadcast and watch live.
accounts: Start local Scorekeeper without an account. Create a free account for Courtside player tracking and to publish live scores or broadcast with FanView.
sharing: Fans with a valid FanView link and internet can follow the live score and watch any active broadcast in a browser without an account or app. Sharing scores and starting video are separate actions.
expiry: The same FanView link stays with the game and expires 15 minutes after the game concludes. It is not a permanent replay archive.
official: For official scorer duties, use the system and training your event requires. A family scoring app does not automatically replace the event’s official scoresheet.
